description: Defines iterator classes and proxies for iterating over a map of string keys to Value objects, including mutable and const variants, within the 'base' namespace.

classes.name: dict_iterator
classes.description: Mutable iterator over DictStorage, abstracts unique_ptr and provides read-write access.

classes.name: const_dict_iterator
classes.description: Immutable iterator over DictStorage, provides read-only access.

classes.name: dict_iterator_proxy
classes.description: Wrapper for begin/end methods returning mutable iterators over DictStorage.

classes.name: const_dict_iterator_proxy
classes.description: Wrapper for begin/end methods returning const iterators over DictStorage.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereferences the iterator to access the current element.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides pointer-like access to the current element.

methods.name: operator++
methods.description: Pre-increment operator to move iterator forward.

methods.name: operator++(int)
methods.description: Post-increment operator to move iterator forward.

methods.name: operator--
methods.description: Pre-decrement operator to move iterator backward.

methods.name: operator--(int)
methods.description: Post-decrement operator to move iterator backward.
